visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a maroon sweatshirt over a light grey zipped hoodie, stands on a paved urban sidewalk at night. She smiles broadly, looking directly at the camera while gesturing enthusiastically with both hands raised in front of her chest. Brightly lit storefronts with yellow and pink signs and numerous pedestrians populate the background under artificial street lighting. (2) The scene cuts to the woman standing outdoors among a crowd of people. Her head is tilted back with her mouth wide open as if yelling or yawning dramatically. She carries a white backpack on her shoulders. Large trees with white promotional posters attached to their trunks are visible in the background, along with many other people in casual clothing. (3) The scene shifts to an indoor cafe with a minimalist industrial design featuring exposed grey concrete walls and a long yellow floating shelf. The woman enters the frame, placing a white paper cup on a small round white table before sitting on a padded bench. She looks toward the camera with a weary but smiling expression, holding the cup. A white question mark logo is visible on the wall behind her.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate the perceived decline in physical stamina for shopping as people enter their late 20s, contrasting initial travel excitement with immediate exhaustion.
